description: This file defines strategies and utilities for tensor sharding in distributed PyTorch, including placeholders, strategy registration, and expansion functions for single-dimension sharding strategies within the distributed tensor framework.

classes.name: _ShardingPlaceholder
classes.description: A placeholder for a sharding placement that has a specified tensor dimension, to be filled in later with concrete sharding types.

methods.name: _insert_single_dim_replication_strategy
methods.description: Inserts a replication strategy (all Replicate) into a list of strategies with placeholders, ensuring no existing all-Replicate strategy is present.

methods.name: _fill_single_dim_strategy_placeholders
methods.description: Replaces _ShardingPlaceholder instances in strategies with specific sharding types based on input placements, supporting implicit replication.

methods.name: _get_unique_placements
methods.description: Extracts a set of unique placement objects from an OpSchema, including tensor specs, strategies, and tuple strategies.

methods.name: _get_num_tensor_inputs
methods.description: Counts the number of tensor inputs in an OpSchema, including tensor strategies and tuple strategies.

methods.name: _expand_single_dim_strategy_to_mesh
methods.description: Expands a single-dimension sharding strategy across all mesh dimensions, generating all combinations of sharding types for input placeholders.

methods.name: register_single_dim_strategy
methods.description: Registers a function that generates non-trivial single-dimension sharding strategies for a specified operator, with support for schema info and argument-specific handling.
